job_title: Full-Stack Java Engineer with TS/SCI Clearance (ETL)
job_description:
A technology solutions company in Maryland is seeking an experienced Software Developer to engage in full-stack Java development, requiring an active TS/SCI polygraph-level security clearance. You will be responsible for backend data storage and ETL development, contributing to innovative projects with modern technologies. The position has a salary range of $127,000-$150,000, depending on experience and geographic location.

Suitable candidates will have at least 7 years of experience and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
